item.title: Version 1.0.32
item.description:
feat: blocked-apps list now seamless across clients

Every active session now stores its blocked_bundle_ids on the
backend.  The "what's hidden right now" disclosure on Home and the
blocked-apps section on useflipped.com/flip both pull from this
server-authoritative list — so the list is correct regardless of
which client started the session (Mac, web, schedule, another Mac).

No user-visible UI changes; just behind-the-scenes correctness.
